caveats.dist_tradeoff: Coefficients trade off against each other, so their scatter can overstate differences in the lens mapping.
caveats.mvis_from_camimu: MVIS values come from the T6 camera+IMU solve, not a camera-only run; not like-for-like.
caveats.settings_differ: Data settings still differ between the tools on this family.
caveats.kalibr_seeded: Kalibr starts from MVIS camera values for each recording; its spread here includes the spread of that input.
caveats.kalibr_gs_elp: Kalibr ran ELP-L as a global-shutter camera with its stamps shifted by the MVIS td of each recording, so the ELP-L rows are left out here.
caveats.kalibr_old_seed: Kalibr's t265 fisheye 1 intrinsics came from an older MVIS export.
caveats.kalibr_view_filtered: Kalibr ran on view-filtered bags (≤ 85°); MVIS and Basalt ran on the full bags.
caveats.basalt_snapped: Basalt's fisheye-2 frames are snapped onto fisheye-1 (1.8–5 ms apart).
caveats.kimu: MVIS here uses Kalibr's IMU model, so the gyro and accel terms mean the same thing in both tools.
caveats.mvis_tga: MVIS also fits a gyro–accel delay (t_ga) that Kalibr and Basalt do not, so its td is not quite the same quantity.
caveats.pairs_differ: The tool pairs here use different parameters, because one tool is not compared on every camera; the cell lists which.
